skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of investment economics and development investment management.
Analyze the nature and role of investment and development investment activities.
Manage state capital and plan investment activities.
Understand business investment activities and procedures.
Evaluate the results and effectiveness of investment activities.
Understand the nature and impact of international investment.
Research, analyze, synthesize, and evaluate issues related to investment activities.
Work independently and in groups, and solve problems related to investment activities.
